theorems.name: Submission.gaussGreenVar_ofReal_integral_inner_le_measure
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (O : Set (Rn N)) (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (ν g : Rn N → Rn N), MeasurableSet O → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖ν x‖ ≤ 1) → tsupport g ⊆ O → (∀ x, ‖g x‖ ≤ 1) → ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x, inner ℝ (g x) (ν x) ∂μ) ≤ μ O
